items.title: Donn Andre interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, June 6, 2009
items.q: But I have played with him a couple of times when he showed up in Washington and came and sat in for a couple of numbers.

ctx.x: What do you think of what Jim Cullum does?

I don’t know, I like that thing. In fact I have something for you, it’s a CD by a fellow who used to be our clarinet player Ron Hockett, who plays for Jim Cullum now and played with us for many years and I also played with Ron on other gigs with other bands. I think he spent his whole career in Washington in the Marines, in the Marine band. So Arbors Records has published something called “Finally Ron” and it’s his own quartet or quintet I guess. It’s very nice stuff. So I have one of those for you. But Cullum is…
Are you familiar with Béla Fleck?
